start.ask_sheet: Share your Google Sheets spreadsheet with {email} as Editor, then send the spreadsheet URL.
start.ask_sheet_no_email: Share your spreadsheet with the service account email as Editor, then send the spreadsheet URL. The key file is not set up on the bot yet.
start.sheet_saved: Created sheet "{title}" within the spreadsheet. Existing sheets were not touched.
start.ready: Hi {name}. What would you like to do?

errors.bad_url: Send a Google Sheets spreadsheet link, like https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/...
errors.not_shared: I cannot open that spreadsheet. Share it with {email} as Editor, then send the URL again.
errors.sheet_failed: I could not set up the spreadsheet. Try again in a moment.
errors.bad_number: Send a number greater than zero.
errors.bad_date: Send a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or pick one below.
errors.bad_name: Send a name up to 100 characters.
errors.bad_currency: Send a currency up to 16 characters, such as MMK.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.need_setup: Send /start to link a spreadsheet first.
errors.tab_missing: The transactions sheet is missing. Link a spreadsheet again from Settings.
errors.sheet_changed: Those rows changed. Start Delete again.
errors.no_credentials: The Google service account key is missing on the bot.

income.ask_name: What is the description for this income?
income.confirm_amount: Amount is {amount} {currency}. Confirm, or type a different amount.

outcome.ask_name: What is the description for this outcome?
outcome.confirm_amount: Amount is {amount} {currency}. Confirm, or type a different amount.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ask_currency: Send the currency to show after amounts, such as MMK.
settings.confirm_sheet: Replace the linked spreadsheet? Data will not be changed or deleted from the old spreadsheet.
settings.sheet_kept: The current spreadsheet is still in use.
